abort.no_devices_found: No compatible connectable ALLPOWERS device was found. Confirm that the device is powered on and visible to a Bluetooth proxy or local adapter.
abort.not_connectable: The discovery source cannot make active Bluetooth connections. Use a connectable ESPHome Bluetooth proxy or a supported local adapter.
abort.not_supported: This ALLPOWERS model uses an unsupported protocol revision.

error.already_configured: This Bluetooth address is already configured in another ALLPOWERS BLE entry.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect through any available Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.connect_timeout: Bluetooth connection could not be established within the probe timeout.
error.gatt_unavailable: The required ALLPOWERS BLE GATT services/characteristics are not available on this device.
error.not_supported: The selected device is not compatible with this integration.
error.notify_failed: Could not enable status notifications from the ALLPOWERS device.
error.timeout: The device connected but did not return a valid status frame before the timeout.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the device. Check the logs for details.

confirm.description: Connect to {name}, verify the FFF0/FFF1/FFF2 GATT interface, and require a checksum-valid status frame before creating the entry?
confirm.title: Add ALLPOWERS power station

user.description: Select a compatible device currently visible to a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.
user.title: Select ALLPOWERS device

reconfigure.description: Update supported entry-level values and validate the selected device before applying changes.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ALLPOWERS BLE

error.out_of_range: Value is outside the allowed range.
error.settings_stale_timeout_must_exceed_keepa: Settings stale timeout must be greater than the settings keepalive interval when keepalive is enabled.
error.stale_timeout_must_exceed_status_interva: Telemetry stale timeout must be greater than the status request interval.
error.watchdog_timeout_must_exceed_stale_timeo: Protocol watchdog timeout must be greater than telemetry stale timeout.

data_description.enable_car_charger: Experimental write path. Keep disabled unless your model/revision has verified support.
data_description.settings_keepalive: Use only when settings data stops updating consistently in your BLE environment.
data_description.settings_keepalive_interval: Lower values increase BLE traffic. Keep this comfortably below settings stale timeout.

init.description: Defaults match the observed R600 behavior. Keepalive and car charger control are disabled unless explicitly enabled. Experimental profiles remain telemetry-only until write capabilities are verified.
init.title: ALLPOWERS BLE options

command_disconnected.message: The device is not currently connected. Wait for Bluetooth reconnection and retry.

command_timeout.message: The command timed out before the device confirmed it. Retry in a few seconds.

command_stale_state.message: A fresh device snapshot is required before this command can be sent. Wait for telemetry to refresh and retry.

command_unsupported.message: This command is not supported by the current model or protocol state.

command_transport.message: Bluetooth transport failed while sending the command. Check connectivity and retry.

command_unconfirmed.message: The device did not confirm the previous command yet. Wait for a fresh update and retry.

invalid_migrated_options.description: The migrated options for {entry_title} are invalid and this entry cannot be loaded safely. Reconfigure the integration entry and keep the default option relationships (`status_interval` < `stale_timeout` < `watchdog_timeout`).
invalid_migrated_options.title: Invalid migrated options in {entry_title}

persistent_no_route.description: Home Assistant cannot find a connectable Bluetooth route for {entry_title} after multiple retries. Check Bluetooth Proxy connectivity, adapter availability, and ensure no other app keeps the station connected.
persistent_no_route.title: No connectable Bluetooth route for {entry_title}

repeated_watchdog_resets.description: The integration had to reconnect {entry_title} repeatedly due to telemetry/transport watchdog resets. Improve BLE signal quality, avoid aggressive timing values, and verify only one active BLE client controls the station.
repeated_watchdog_resets.title: Repeated watchdog reconnects for {entry_title}
